topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: Well, I'll be a farmer's uncle! So, this friend of mine, always jabbering on about this and that from across the great waters, turns out to be just a stone's throw away. All these tales of far-off places, and here we are, neighbors. The nerve! I toil from dawn to dusk, and what do I get? A secret-keeper. Next time I see him, I might just ask him to help me with the harvest, see if he knows anything about plowing more than words. Saints have mercy, the likes of him. What a day, what a find. I’ll wager the barn rats are more trustworthy!
